'''Finn Ertay''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Ertay attended a meeting in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Holograph|broadcast]] his [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|capture]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]], prompting a Jedi-led [[Battle group/Legends|task force]] to [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|rescue]] Koth from Grievous's clutches. Ertay was also present when a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] returned to the Temple from [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisonment]] on the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. When the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] began to target a number of [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] outposts circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Ertay and a [[Unidentified Nikto Jedi/Legends|Nikto Jedi]] [[Duel at unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|confronted]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] brothers at an [[Unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|Outer Rim spaceport]]. They attempted to save their comrade from Opress's [[Savage Opress's lightsaber/Legends|blade]] in the ensuing [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], but both Jedi were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] by the Nightbrothers.

==Biography==
The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Finn Ertay<ref name="Explore: Revival" /> lived during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> they received [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="Grievous Intrigue Ep Guide" /> and became a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fought between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war,<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Ertay was present at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when a meeting was called at the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Temple communication center]]. Attending alongside a number of their colleagues, Ertay witnessed Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[holograph]]ically broadcast his [[Torture/Legends|torture]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]], a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] whom the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] General had captured during a [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|battle]]<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> near the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]].<ref name="FF-2014 21">{{FactFile2014|21|21 BBY 3-6|Intrigues in the Outer Rim}}</ref> When Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] ordered away the present [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], Ertay was among those,<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> including [[Eekar Oki/Legends|Eekar Oki]],<ref name="Grievous Intrigue Ep Guide" /> who withdrew from the room. Koth was later [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|freed]] from Grievous's custody thanks to the efforts of a Jedi-led [[Battle group/Legends|task force]] from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

[[File:DuelAtSpaceport-Revival.png|thumb|left|250px|Ertay comes to the aid of her Nikto comrade, shortly before being killed by Darth Maul.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 7">{{FactFile2014|7|KAT 1-2|King Katuunko}}</ref> when a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] was rescued from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]], where they had been [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|hunted]] for sport by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]], Ertay joined Oki and several [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] members in welcoming the younglings back to the Jedi Temple upon their arrival aboard the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] [[Halo/Legends|''Halo'']]. Ertay spoke with the initiate [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]] on the landing platform before the group proceeded back into the Temple.<ref name="Wookiee Hunt">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref> Later, around the war's [[20 BBY/Legends|third year]],<ref name="Death Sentence 1" /> the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] and self-proclaimed [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] began a scourge through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], targeting a number of poorly defended outposts in that area of the galaxy.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Maul">{{SWE|characters|darthmaul|Darth Maul}}</ref> Ertay teamed up with a [[Unidentified Nikto Jedi/Legends|Nikto Jedi]] to [[Duel at unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|confront]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] brothers at an [[Unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|Outer Rim spaceport]].<ref name="Revival" />

While their [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] comrade faced down Opress in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], Ertay took on Maul, employing their acrobatic skills in their [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]]. When Ertay saw Opress kick the Nikto to the ground, they ducked between Maul's [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and brought their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] up to intercept a strike from Opress's [[Savage Opress's lightsaber/Legends|blade]] that would have [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Nikto. However, that move allowed Maul to assail her from behind. Ertay was struck through the back by Maul's [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], falling to the Nightbrothers alongside their Nikto companion. Their deaths, in addition to the recent Outer Rim attacks, prompted Jedi Masters [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] to track down Maul and Opress, who were forced into a [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|showdown]] on the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="Revival" />

==Personality and traits==
Finn Ertay had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Ertay served the Republic as a member of the Jedi Order. During the duel at the Outer Rim [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Ertay attempted to defend their fellow Nikto Jedi when he was struck down by Savage Opress, though their decision enabled [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maul to exploit their momentary preoccupation and kill them.<ref name="Revival" />

==Powers and abilities==
Finn Ertay was sensitive to the Force and trained as a Jedi. In addition to a proficiency in lightsaber combat, they possessed acrobatic skill, ducking under Darth Maul's cybernetic legs to intercept Savage Opress's blade in a single fluid motion. Despite their faculty for combat, Ertay was unable to withstand the combined efforts of the two Nightbrothers.<ref name="Revival" />

==Equipment==
Being a Twi'lek, Ertay wore a headpiece around their pair of [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]], along with a [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robe]] and with [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. They wielded a lightsaber with a blue [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="Revival" />

==Behind the scenes==
Finn Ertay was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, mainly appearing as a background Jedi character throughout their appearances in the series.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /><ref name="Wookiee Hunt" /> Ertay was introduced in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode "[[Grievous Intrigue]]," which aired on [[January 1]], [[2010]], being identified by name in the episode's [https://web.archive.org/web/20100328063657/http://www.starwars.com/theclonewars/guide/episode209.html corresponding guide] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue Ep Guide" /> The character was again featured in the episode "[[Wookiee Hunt]],"<ref name="Wookiee Hunt" /> which aired on [[April 1]], [[2011]] with the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]].<ref name="Wookiee Hunt Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode322.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Wookiee Hunt}}</ref> In the Newsreel of "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]]," the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season's]] premiere episode, their death was depicted at the blade of Darth Maul. The episode was released on [[September 29]], [[2012]].<ref name="Explore: Revival" />

The story adaptation of "Wookiee Hunt" in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Annual 2012]]'' states that during the scene in which O-Mer and the other Jedi younglings return to the Jedi Temple from Wasskah, the young Jedi are "reunited with their masters."<ref name="TCW Annual 2012">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Annual 2012]]''</ref> Given that in the episode, Ertay is among the Jedi who greet the newly returned younglings at the Temple,<ref name="Wookiee Hunt" /> the possibility that they are one of the "masters" implied, though the text does not explicitly mention Ertay by name.<ref name="TCW Annual 2012" /> To date, any official connection has yet to be clarified.
